## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-*juan* personal vow-arousing text by Zhìyǐ 智顗, paralleling Huìsī's *Lìshìyuàn wén* ([KR6d0182](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0182)) as one of the early Tiāntái tradition's personal-vow declarations.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Zhìyǐ's productive period c. 575–597.
